items.exampleEn: Please arrive two hours before departure.
items.exampleZh: 請在出發前兩小時抵達。

items.exampleEn: This island is a popular destination for families.
items.exampleZh: 這座島是很受家庭歡迎的旅遊目的地。

items.exampleEn: We will depart early to avoid the traffic.
items.exampleZh: 我們會早點出發，避開車潮。

items.exampleEn: My uncle rides his motorcycle to work.
This backpack is light but strong.
We took the ferry to the island.
Each passenger may bring one piece of baggage.
items.exampleZh: 每位乘客可攜帶一件行李。

items.sentenceEn: The ferry was late because of the strong wind.

items.audioEn: Flight 207 will depart from Gate 12 in Terminal 1.
items.audioZh: 207 號班機將從第一航廈 12 號登機門出發。
items.questionZh: 207 號班機從哪個登機門出發？

items.sentenceZh: 你的最終目的地是哪裡？

items.sentenceEn: Leave your baggage here and collect it later.
items.sentenceZh: 把行李留在這裡，晚點再來拿。

items.stemEn: The ____ time on my ticket is 10:30, so we must leave home at eight.
items.stemZh: 我票上的出發時間是 10:30，所以我們八點就得出門。

items.stemEn: I carry my books and lunch in a ____ on my back.
items.stemZh: 我把書和午餐放在背上的背包裡。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, Ian visited his aunt, who lives on a small island. He packed a backpack instead of a suitcase because the ferry has limits on baggage. The ferry departs from the harbor every two hours. Ian arrived at the terminal early, but his departure was delayed by thirty minutes because of fog. When he reached his destination, his aunt was waiting for him on her old motorcycle.
items.passageZh: 上週末，Ian 去拜訪住在一座小島上的阿姨。他背了一個背包而不是帶行李箱，因為渡輪對行李有限制。渡輪每兩小時從港口開出一班。Ian 很早就到了碼頭的候船站，但因為起霧，出發時間延誤了三十分鐘。他抵達目的地時，阿姨正騎著她的舊機車在等他。

questions.questionZh: Ian 為什麼背背包而不帶行李箱？

items.promptZh: 下一班公車十分鐘後出發。
referenceEn: The next bus departs in ten minutes.
The next bus will depart in ten minutes.
rubricZh: 時態配合內容（例如 departs、will depart、is departing 等）
「十分鐘後」可寫，例如 in ten minutes 等

referenceEn: Motorcycles are not allowed on this road.
rubricZh: 用 motorcycle 的複數表示「機車」
「禁止通行」可寫，例如 are not allowed on、can't use 等
